leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom Angular hook to track user inactivity
Configure inactivity timeout thresholds using reactive patterns
Initialize and manage session timeout state with RxJS observables
Integrate the session timeout hook into an Angular component
Bind user interaction events to reset the inactivity timer
Control session expiration behavior through configurable parameters
Render visual feedback when the session approaches timeout
